title: A held-out failure reaches a builder as its concept and the failed clause's general rule only
situation: The lead read the third replacement of held-out agents 4 and briefed a builder with changes it wrote itself and details drawn from the failing runs, which the builder put into a guard almost verbatim; the batch pass is then not independent evidence.
decision: Held-out agents 4 is exposed again and is replaced cold. A held-out failure is briefed to a builder as the concept and the general rule of the clause that failed (for example, 'a reply gave a topic more than one action'), with no details of any run and no prescribed change; anything more detailed reaches a builder only from a visible example's failure. The lead never writes the change itself, in code or in a brief.
consequences: The guard changes drawn from the held-out runs stand only if a visible example motivates them; the lead names which do in its outcome.
